descriptions.notStarted: Manji, who has received Mu Young's messages, seems to have a favor to ask of you.
descriptions.inProgress: Manji has asked that you deliver his request to Mu Young, who is currently in the Underground Temple inside the dungeon. Let's deliver Manji's request to Mu Young.
descriptions.completed: Manji has asked that you deliver his request to Mu Young, who is in the Underground Temple inside the dungeon. Upon receiving Manji's request, Mu Young promised himself that he would always remain mindful of his master's request.
